speaker: Unknown
en: We should hopefully see that the agent tries to use, ah, it uses Google Search in this case on 2nd of July.

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me quickly check here.

en: So the agent became more of a general purpose agent, and we don't need to specify all of the tools.

speaker: Unknown
en: We basically trust the model on understanding, hey, I have a specific set of very atomic general purpose tools to solve my task or a task for the user.

speaker: Unknown
en: And if we look at the code,

speaker: Unknown

zh: 对于输入，或者说，抱歉，是接口，我们这里有我们的 sources,所以我们有安装了 GitHub CLI 的 bash 脚本，我们有 agents.md 文件，然后我们说：嘿，你可以带凭证使用 GitHub API,所以我想以一种安全的方式访问或使用 GitHub 凭证，所以我创建了一个 token,

speaker: Unknown
en: That we keep the multi-turn going.

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's all it takes.
zh: 这就是全部所需的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's a single API call on the backend side.
zh: 在后端就是一次 API 调用。

speaker: Unknown
en: We start that Cloud Sandbox.

speaker: Unknown
en: We load the H&MD file and the skills from the environment provided to the model.
zh: 我们加载提供给模型的 H&MD 文件和 skills。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the model between the API and the Sandbox does all of the looping, calling the function, returning the function results, calling the function, returning the function results.
zh: 然后模型在 API 和沙箱之间做所有的循环，调用函数，返回函数结果，调用函数，返回函数结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that is all it takes.
zh: 这就是全部所需的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Where does it leave us?
zh: 这让我们处于什么位置？

speaker: Unknown
en: We no longer need to execute loops.
zh: 我们不再需要执行循环。

speaker: Unknown
en: We no longer need to do true routing.
zh: 我们不再需要做真正的路由。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a server-side conversation and session state, so we only need to provide new inputs.
zh: 我们有服务器端的对话和会话状态，所以我们只需要提供新的输入。

speaker: Unknown
en: The context window and the compaction is also automatically managed by the agent.
zh: 上下文窗口和压缩也由智能体自动管理。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if we continue our conversation at a certain point, the context is compacted, and we can continue without the need to manage anything.
zh: 所以如果我们在某个节点继续我们的对话，上下文会被压缩，我们可以继续而无需管理任何东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we also get an isolated remote Linux sandbox, which we can use to run our code.
zh: 我们还得到一个隔离的远程 Linux 沙箱，我们可以用它来运行我们的代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what is still left for us?
zh: 那么还剩下什么留给我们？

speaker: Unknown
en: We need to define instructions.
zh: 我们需要定义指令。

speaker: Unknown
en: We need to define rules, behaviors in an agents.md file.
zh: 我们需要在 agents.md 文件中定义规则、行为。

speaker: Unknown
en: We need to provide capabilities or context and skills.md, and we need to own the evals.
zh: 我们需要提供能力或上下文和 skills.md,并且我们需要拥有 evals。

speaker: Unknown
en: So all of the heavy lifting, the infrastructure management, all of the same code, which probably everyone has written of us here like 20 times is no longer needed, and you can start really building your product instead of needing to rewrite the same code over and over again.
zh: 所以所有繁重的工作，基础设施管理，所有那些我们这里的每个人可能都写过 20 遍的同样的代码，都不再需要了，你可以真正开始构建你的产品，而不需要一遍又一遍地重写同样的代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: And very important is like, hey, that's great, but what about extending?
zh: 非常重要的是，嘿，这很棒，但是扩展性呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think looking into how extending previous agents to like those new agents work, it's very obvious that previously, if we want to do like some kind of security scanning on a pull request, we would need to define or write a Python function.
zh: 我认为看看把之前的智能体扩展到这类新智能体是如何工作的，很明显，以前，如果我们想对 pull request 做某种安全扫描，我们需要定义或编写一个 Python 函数。

speaker: Unknown
en: We would need to understand, okay, which CLI tools do we need to use?
zh: 我们需要理解，好，我们需要使用哪些 CLI 工具？

speaker: Unknown
en: We need to define a new function schema, and then we needed to add it to our tools.
zh: 我们需要定义一个新的函数 schema,然后把它加到我们的工具里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Need to run it, and so there's a lot of things we need to do on agents powered by files.
zh: 需要运行它，等等，所以在由文件驱动的智能体上，我们要做很多事。

speaker: Unknown
en: We write a SkillsMD file, maybe with some additional information on which CLI tool to use, or maybe provide a CLI tool inside the environment, and then we extend the capabilities.
zh: 我们写一个 SkillsMD 文件，可能带上一些关于使用哪个 CLI 工具的额外信息，或者可能在环境里提供一个 CLI 工具，然后我们就扩展了能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't need to change our code, we just provide more files to the agent, and the agent decides on what we want to do.
zh: 我们不需要改代码，我们只是给智能体提供更多文件，然后由智能体决定要做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I like to bring up some very good examples.
zh: 我很喜欢举一些非常好的例子。

speaker: Unknown
en: So at AI engineer in Europe, Cursor did a great talk on how they replaced roughly 12,000 lines of TypeScript code with 200 lines agent files to create something similar.
zh: 在欧洲的 AI Engineer 大会上，Cursor 做了一个很棒的演讲，讲他们如何用 200 行 agent 文件替换了大约 12000 行 TypeScript 代码来创建类似的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they had a very
zh: 所以他们有一个非常

speaker: Unknown
en: Hardcoded code orchestration for doing Git Worktrees, and they were able to replace it with just a skill and markdown files, and there are more, I would say, better lessons of agent engineering.
zh: 硬编码的代码编排来做 Git Worktrees,而他们能够只用一个 skill 和 markdown 文件替换它，而且还有更多，我想说，更好的智能体工程的经验教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: Manos has refactored their harness five times in six months last year.
zh: Manos 在去年六个月内重构了他们的 harness 五次。

speaker: Unknown
en: LangChain has re-architected their OpenDeep research three times a year, and then also Vercel has removed 80% of their tools to achieve fewer steps, faster responses, and better accuracy.
zh: LangChain 一年内重新架构了他们的 OpenDeep research 三次，还有 Vercel 移除了 80% 的工具，以实现更少的步骤、更快的响应和更好的准确性。

speaker: Unknown
en: An obvious trend that with better model capabilities, we can remove orchestration code, but if your harness is getting more complex as the model improves, you are most likely overengineering your harness.
zh: 一个明显的趋势是,随着模型能力提升,我们可以移除编排代码,但如果你的 harness 在模型进步时反而变得更复杂,你很可能是在过度工程化你的 harness。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, if you struggle with model improvements and adding new capabilities which lead to more complexity and more code, you might need to rethink a little bit on how your agent harness looks.
zh: 所以,如果你苦于模型进步和增加新能力反而带来更多复杂性和更多代码,你可能需要重新思考一下你的智能体 harness 应该长什么样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, where does it end up?
zh: 那么,它最终会走向哪里?

speaker: Unknown
en: Agents are just files.
zh: 智能体就只是文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: We write markdown files to extend capabilities.
zh: 我们编写 markdown 文件来扩展能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Agents can learn from those, can create their own files.
zh: 智能体可以从这些文件中学习,也可以创建自己的文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, if you have a session and tell the agent to remember something, to take notes of rules of preferences, the agent just writes it to disk and then can reuse it in the later session.
zh: 所以,如果你在一次会话中告诉智能体记住某件事,记下规则或偏好的笔记,智能体就只是把它写到磁盘上,然后在之后的会话中复用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can also externalize context.
zh: 你还可以把上下文外置。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, if you have a very long-running session,
zh: 比如,如果你有一个运行时间很长的会话,

speaker: Unknown
en: And during that session, you notice, hey, maybe I want to additionally work on another feature.
zh: 在那个会话中,你注意到,嘿,也许我还想额外做另一个功能。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can, like, just write that information, that handoff to a file, and, like, tell the agent to later pick it up.
zh: 你可以,呃,把这些信息、这个交接写到文件里,然后,呃,告诉智能体之后去接手。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so what are the takeaways?
zh: 那么要点是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: We should not fight the model.
zh: 我们不应该和模型对抗。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, we should stop micromanaging the execution paths, provide general tools to the agent, and let the model explore.
zh: 比如,我们应该停止微管理执行路径,给智能体提供通用的工具,让模型去探索。

speaker: Unknown
en: Reason and discover the right solution.
zh: 推理并发现正确的解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: Own what is yours, meaning focus on your domain instructions, focus on the workflows, focus especially on the evals, define clean tools, and verify the outcomes, and really build to delete.
zh: 掌管属于你的部分,意思是专注于你的领域指令,专注于工作流,尤其专注于 evals,定义干净的工具,并验证结果,真正做到为删除而构建。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, we have seen in the past many, many times, the better the model gets, the more code we can remove, and the more things we need to change.
zh: 比如,我们在过去已经见过很多很多次,模型越好,我们能移除的代码就越多,我们需要改变的东西也越多。

speaker: Unknown
en: And obviously, we all want to benefit from better models.
